canonicalPrompt.text:
Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Adu Morar: 18-year-old man, 158 cm (short), conditioned athletic construction with functional tone but no ripped definition, skin value band-6-deepest. Face: wide triangular face; large hooded eyes and a broken brow line; short rounded nose, wide mouth; one brow notch. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: brown-chestnut, braids-twists-locs, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: mantle-short-cape, specifically a small mantle or short cape over an unarmored tunic and divided lower layers; visible hand repairs and contrasting inner edges; bounded palette plum-gray. Visible personal details: a narrow bracelet stack; a repaired cuff with bright thread. Make the garment hem and outer silhouette the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: immaculate clothes over weathered hands. Color treatment: uses the palette boldly in large blocks. Pose cue: chin remains level while one hand lightly checks a cuff seam. Include a tiny cloth-wrapped notebook only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
